title: Which Part of Your Body Has No Blood Vessels?
description:
One transparent body tissue stays alive without a single blood vessel.

The cornea. It receives oxygen from tears and the air, and nutrients from surrounding fluids and tissues.

Its lack of vessels helps keep it transparent for vision. The cornea is richly supplied with nerves despite being avascular.

The cornea is one of the most densely innervated tissues in the body.
